figures.claim: Conventional teaching places the injury event within the first 50 milliseconds of ground contact, which is faster than a voluntary or reflex correction.
Peak vertical ground reaction force in landing is conventionally given as three to six times body weight, arriving at a knee flexed roughly 20 degrees or less.
